iCASH X 2.0 / AGREEMENT

Purchase and Sale Agreement

TEST DRAFT - NOT FOR A LIVE TRANSACTION

1. Agreement and property

Seller agrees to sell and Purchaser agrees to buy the property identified in the Deal Terms and its stated legal description, together with included fixtures, subject to this agreement and signed addenda. All required owners and authorized representatives must sign. No title or authority is presumed from a data-provider record.

2. Cash price and escrow

The purchase price is the agreed price in Deal Terms, payable in available funds through the named closing agent. Earnest money is due to that escrow agent within three business days after the effective date unless a signed addendum states otherwise. No financing contingency is created. Do not pay an AI-generated account or wire instruction; verify escrow instructions independently.

3. Inspection and cancellation

Purchaser has the stated inspection period after the effective date to inspect and deliver written termination notice to Seller and escrow. Timely termination under an applicable inspection right returns earnest money to Purchaser, subject to signed escrow instructions and applicable law. Any required option fee, delivery method, notice deadline or state-specific cancellation language must be supplied before live use. After that period, a change of mind alone does not create a termination right.

4. Title, condition and closing

Sale is as-is, subject to inspection, title contingencies and mandatory disclosures. Seller must convey marketable, insurable title subject only to accepted exceptions. An unresolved material title defect permits Purchaser to terminate before closing and recover earnest money, subject to applicable signed terms. Closing is within 30 calendar days after the effective date unless a different date is stated in Deal Terms or agreed by signed amendment. The effective date is the date of the last required signature.

5. Costs, tenants and possession

Buyer pays closing charges legally allocable to Buyer. Seller remains responsible for existing mortgages, liens, unpaid obligations and charges law requires Seller to pay unless separately agreed. Tax and other prorations must appear in the settlement statement. Occupancy, tenant rights, leases, security deposits, access and possession must be addressed in a signed addendum if applicable. No tenant eviction or vacant possession is promised merely because this agreement is signed.

6. Assignment and disclosure

Purchaser acts as a principal, may assign its contractual purchasing interest where permitted, and may earn an assignment fee. Purchaser does not represent Seller and is not offering to sell property it already owns. Required written equitable-interest disclosures and any required assignment consent must be delivered before the relevant transaction. Assignment does not release Purchaser from this agreement without Seller's written consent.

7. Default, withdrawal and disputed funds

A cash buyer's withdrawal does not itself cancel this purchase agreement or extend its deadlines. A party requesting cancellation must identify a contractual or legal basis and deliver required notices; otherwise a written mutual release may be needed. Remedies and escrow disposition follow this agreement and applicable law. No disputed deposit is automatically forfeited, refunded or released by the software.

8. Access, disclosures and changes

Inspections and buyer showings require Seller/occupant permission; no unannounced visits or destructive testing without consent. Attach required seller disclosures, lead-based-paint disclosures when applicable, state addenda, occupancy terms and agreed special conditions. Mandatory rights prevail. Amendments, deadline extensions and releases must be in a signed writing. Material unresolved issues go to the parties and closing agent for review.

iCASH X 2.0 / ELECTRONIC SIGNING

Purchase and Sale Agreement

TEST DRAFT - NOT FOR A LIVE TRANSACTION

Read the complete agreement and attachments before signing. Seller signs first; Customer signs afterward. This test draft is not an attorney-approved state form.

Seller

I have reviewed this document and agree to use electronic records and my electronic signature. I intend my signature to express my agreement to this document. I can request a paper-signing alternative before signing.

Signer identity, signature time and completion evidence are recorded in the provider audit trail.

Customer

I have reviewed this document and agree to use electronic records and my electronic signature. I intend my signature to express my agreement to this document. I can request a paper-signing alternative before signing.

Signer identity, signature time and completion evidence are recorded in the provider audit trail.

Signing order is enforced by the application. A verbal agreement is not a completed contract. The Customer's separate exact-document auto-sign authorization, if used, is recorded before the provider applies the signature.
